title: tilia americana var. neglecta
intro: Tilia americana var. neglecta, commonly known as American Linden, is a variety of the American Basswood tree, native to North America. The bark, leaves, and flowers of this plant are used in herbal medicine, providing various health benefits, including reducing anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and supporting respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of American Linden include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as insomnia, restlessness, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of American Linden include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
